repos_data.description: The open-source Higgsfield desktop app for Mac. Unofficial native client: make video and images with Genjutsu, Seedance 2.5, Kling and Wan, and keep every file on your disk. Free. Not affiliated with Higgsfield AI.

Free, open-source app to swap a character in a video on Mac. No watermark. Seedance 2.5 or Wan 2.2 Animate with on-device prep (Vision, Core ML, MLX). A Viggle and Higgsfield Recast alternative. Unofficial.
